entries.proposition: One male infant carries a de novo heterozygous 16q deletion including WWOX, ANKRD11, ZNF778, CDH15 and CDH13, with callosal dysgenesis, hydrocephaly and microcephaly.

entries.proposition: Exome sequencing was limited to six selected patients.
entries.snippet: Whole-exome sequencing (WES) was performed in six selected patients whose clinical phenotype remained incompletely explained after chromosomal microarray analysis.

entries.proposition: Only four exome-sequenced patients carried variants, listed in Table 1.
entries.snippet: TABLE 1 Sequence variants identified by WES in four patients.
Genomic coordinates were reported according to the hg18 human reference genome.

entries.proposition: The authors call the network analyses exploratory, not evidence of pathogenicity.
entries.snippet: these analyses provide functional context rather than independent evidence of pathogenicity and should therefore be considered exploratory.
